note: Deep-dive #2. Sweden Central for Azure OpenAI. Python on the laptop is 3.10 (demo.md asks 3.11+): check pip install works, else add 3.11. Two browser profiles: Alex and Sam.
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded
az login --use-device-code
az provider register --namespace Microsoft.CognitiveServices --wait
$env:MG_TENANT_ID = az account show --query tenantId -o tsv
python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt
# manual (Entra admin center as labadmin): groups 'HR Copilot - Employees' (Alex, Sam) and 'HR Copilot - Managers' (Sam)

az ad group create --display-name 'HR Copilot - Employees' --mail-nickname hrcopilot-employees -o none; az ad group create --display-name 'HR Copilot - Managers' --mail-nickname hrcopilot-managers -o none

foreach ($u in 'alex.demo','sam.demo') { $oid = az ad user list --filter "startswith(userPrincipalName,'$u@')" --query '[0].id' -o tsv; az ad group member add --group 'HR Copilot - Employees' --member-id $oid }
az ad group member add --group 'HR Copilot - Managers' --member-id (az ad user list --filter "startswith(userPrincipalName,'sam.demo@')" --query '[0].id' -o tsv)
Copy-Item indexer/libraries.json indexer/libraries.local.json -Force   # then put the two real group object ids in it (never committed)

# manual: app registrations 'HR Copilot API' (Expose an API, user_impersonation, groups claim = groups assigned to the application, both groups assigned), 'HR Copilot Connector' (client secret, admin consent), 'HR Copilot Indexer' (client secret, Graph Sites.Selected application permission, read grant on /sites/hr-lab)

# manual: SharePoint site /sites/hr-lab with libraries Policies (leave-policy.md, travel-policy.md, it-faq.md, handbook.docx) and Managers (salary-bands.md, permissions broken, only HR Copilot - Managers)
$env:MG_API_CLIENT = Read-Host 'HR Copilot API client id (owner types)'; $env:MG_IDX_CLIENT = Read-Host 'HR Copilot Indexer client id (owner types)'
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-02 -l swedencentral -o none

az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-02 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p apiClientId=$env:MG_API_CLIENT ingestPrincipalId=$(az ad sp show --id $env:MG_IDX_CLIENT --query id -o tsv) ingestPrincipalType=ServicePrincipal --query properties.outputs -o json > $env:TEMP\copilot-outputs.json
$o = Get-Content $env:TEMP\copilot-outputs.json | ConvertFrom-Json
Push-Location src; func azure functionapp publish $o.functionAppName.value; Pop-Location
$env:SEARCH_ENDPOINT = $o.searchEndpoint.value; $env:OPENAI_ENDPOINT = $o.openAiEndpoint.value; $env:SEARCH_INDEX = 'hr-policies'
$env:AZURE_TENANT_ID = $env:MG_TENANT_ID; $env:AZURE_CLIENT_ID = $env:MG_IDX_CLIENT
Set-Item Env:AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET (Read-Host -MaskInput 'HR Copilot Indexer secret (owner types)')
Start-Sleep -Seconds 180   # role assignment propagation (a 403 from Search or OpenAI right after deployment means wait)
python indexer/cli.py create-index

# manual: custom connector from connector/apiDefinition.swagger.json (host = function host, OAuth 2.0 Entra ID, HR Copilot Connector, resource api://<API client id>), copy Redirect URL into the connector app registration; test AskHrPolicies as Alex
# manual: Copilot Studio agent 'HR Policy Copilot' in DEV: authenticate with Microsoft, tool = AskHrPolicies (user authentication), instructions as in demo.md; give sam.demo maker access to DEV
# manual: injection check (off camera): as Alex ask 'How do I reset my password?' and write the real outcome in the README

screens.name: ingest-run
also: Group object ids in the output are replaced on screen by <group-id>; the output itself is real

screens.name: employee
steps: Sign in as Alex Demo (own browser profile), environment DEV, open the agent HR Policy Copilot
Ask: Can I carry over leave days?  (answer with a citation to the leave policy)
Ask: What's the salary range for band M2?  (expect: I couldn't find this in the documents you have access to.)
If the agent paraphrases, keep it when facts and citation are right
mask: user principal name (keep display name Alex Demo)
function host name in any tool detail

screens.name: manager
steps: Sign in as Sam Demo (own browser profile), environment DEV, open HR Policy Copilot > Test your agent
Ask: What's the salary range for band M2?
Show the answer: 66,000 to 82,000 EUR with a citation to Contoso salary bands 2027
mask: user principal name (keep display name Sam Demo)

teardown: Remove-Item Env:AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, Env:AZURE_CLIENT_ID, Env:AZURE_TENANT_ID, Env:SEARCH_ENDPOINT, Env:OPENAI_ENDPOINT, Env:SEARCH_INDEX -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# manual: purge the soft-deleted Azure OpenAI and Cognitive Services accounts (portal) if the names are needed again
# manual: delete the custom connector and connections, the Copilot Studio agent, the three app registrations, the two groups, the Policies and Managers libraries
